The '''SR-88 Cryo-mine''' was a model of [[Proximity mine/Legends|proximity mine]] used during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:SR88CM" />

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The SR-88 Cryo-mine appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:SR88CM" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The SR-88 Cryo-mine was added to the game with the release of the the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 3|Chapter 3]]," on [[September 27]], [[2006]].<ref name="CA2006">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64186&resource=publish|text=Chapter Archive 2006}}</ref> The weapon could be purchased from a [[Recruitment officer/Legends|faction recruiter]] by players who had achieved the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Master Sergeant/Legends|master sergeant]]/[[senior sergeant]].<ref name="SWG:SR88CM" />
